# Calculate wheel positions for a toy car
# Body dimensions: 200x100x100
# Wheel radius: 25, thickness: 10
# Wheels need to be at bottom corners, half embedded

# The wheels are cylinders oriented along the Y-axis (thickness direction)
# Half embedded means the center is at z = 0 (bottom of car)

# Front-left wheel

fl_y = 0   # Start at left edge
fl_z = 0   # Center at bottom

# Front-right wheel  
fr_x = 25  # Same x as front-left
fr_y = 90  # Right edge minus thickness (100-10)
fr_z = 0   # Center at bottom

# Rear-left wheel
rl_x = 175  # Near rear edge (200-25)
rl_y = 0    # Start at left edge
rl_z = 0    # Center at bottom

# Rear-right wheel
rr_x = 175  # Same x as rear-left
rr_y = 90   # Right edge minus thickness
rr_z = 0    # Center at bottom

print(f"Front-left wheel: ({fl_x}, {fl_y}, {fl_z})")
print(f"Front-right wheel: ({fr_x}, {fr_y}, {fr_z})")
print(f"Rear-left wheel: ({rl_x}, {rl_y}, {rl_z})")
print(f"Rear-right wheel: ({rr_x}, {rr_y}, {rr_z})")
print(f"Height vector for all wheels: (0, 10, 0) - pointing along Y-axis with length 10")
